chapterInfo.content:
27
AWURADE ne me hann ne me nkwagyeɛ
Dawid deɛ.
1 # Dwom 56.4; Yes 12.2 AWURADE ne me hann ne me nkwagyeɛ,
hwan na mensuro no?
AWURADE ne me nkwa ahoɔden,
hwan anim na me ho mpopoɔ?
2 # Hiob 19.22 Nnipa bɔne a wɔhyɛ me so
na wɔtane me,
sɛ wɔretoa me abɛsunsuane me a,
wɔawatiwatiri na wɔahwehwe ase.
3 # Dwom 3.6 Sɛ dɔm kyere me so nsraban a,
m’akoma rentu;
sɛ wɔtu me so sa a,
ɛno mu mpo na me ho tɔ me.
4 # Dwom 23.6; 26.6-8; 42.4; 63.2; 84.3-4 Adeɛ baako na masrɛ AWURADE,
ɛno na mɛhwehwɛ akyiri kwan;
sɛ me nna a medie nyinaa
mɛtena AWURADE fie,
na mahwɛ AWURADE animteɛ,
na madwene me tirim wɔ n’asɔrefie.
5 # Dwom 31.20; 40.2 Na ɔkora me ne sese mu
wɔ hia da,
ɔde me hunta ne ntomadan ahuntaeɛ,
ɔma me so gyina ɔbotan so.
6Na afei ɔbɛma me tiri so,
m’atamfoɔ a wɔatwa me ho ahyia no so,
na mabɔ ne ntomadan mu
ayeyie afɔdeɛ,
na mato AWURADE sankuo dwom.
7AWURADE, tie me sufrɛ;
hu me mmɔbɔ, na gye me so.
8 # Deut 4.29 Woaka sɛ: Monhwehwɛ m’anim, nti,
m’akoma se wo sɛ:
AWURADE, w’anim na merehwehwɛ.
9Nyi w’anim nhunta me,
mfa abufuo mpamo w’akoa.
Me boafoɔ ne wo,
nto me ntwene, na nnya me,
me nkwagyeɛ Nyankopɔn.
10 # Yes 49.15 Na m’agya ne me na agya me,
na AWURADE deɛ, ɔgye me.
11 # Dwom 25.4; 86.11; 139.24 AWURADE, kyerɛ me wo kwan,
na fa me fa ɔtempɔn tamaa so,
m’atɛfoɔ nti.
12Nnane me mma sɛdeɛ m’atamfoɔ pɛ,
na adansekurumfoɔ asɔre atia me,
ne wɔn a wɔpu aniɛdensɛm.
13 # Dwom 142.5; Yes 38.11 Megye medi sɛ mɛhunu AWURADE ayamyɛ,
ateasefoɔ asase so.
14 # Dwom 31.24 Ma w’ani nna AWURADE so,
hyɛ wo ho den na ma wo bo nyɛ duru,
Aane, ma w’ani nna AWURADE so.

pageProps.chapterText:
AWURADE ne me hann ne me nkwagyeɛ,
hwan na mensuro no?
AWURADE ne me nkwa ahoɔden,
hwan anim na me ho mpopoɔ?
Nnipa bɔne a wɔhyɛ me so
na wɔtane me,
sɛ wɔretoa me abɛsunsuane me a,
wɔawatiwatiri na wɔahwehwe ase.
Sɛ dɔm kyere me so nsraban a,
m’akoma rentu;
sɛ wɔtu me so sa a,
ɛno mu mpo na me ho tɔ me.
Adeɛ baako na masrɛ AWURADE,
ɛno na mɛhwehwɛ akyiri kwan;
sɛ me nna a medie nyinaa
mɛtena AWURADE fie,
na mahwɛ AWURADE animteɛ,
na madwene me tirim wɔ n’asɔrefie.
Na ɔkora me ne sese mu
wɔ hia da,
ɔde me hunta ne ntomadan ahuntaeɛ,
ɔma me so gyina ɔbotan so.
Na afei ɔbɛma me tiri so,
m’atamfoɔ a wɔatwa me ho ahyia no so,
na mabɔ ne ntomadan mu
ayeyie afɔdeɛ,
na mato AWURADE sankuo dwom.
AWURADE, tie me sufrɛ;
hu me mmɔbɔ, na gye me so.
Woaka sɛ: Monhwehwɛ m’anim, nti,
m’akoma se wo sɛ:
AWURADE, w’anim na merehwehwɛ.
Nyi w’anim nhunta me,
mfa abufuo mpamo w’akoa.
Me boafoɔ ne wo,
nto me ntwene, na nnya me,
me nkwagyeɛ Nyankopɔn.
Na m’agya ne me na agya me,
na AWURADE deɛ, ɔgye me.
AWURADE, kyerɛ me wo kwan,
na fa me fa ɔtempɔn tamaa so,
m’atɛfoɔ nti.
Nnane me mma sɛdeɛ m’atamfoɔ pɛ,
na adansekurumfoɔ asɔre atia me,
ne wɔn a wɔpu aniɛdensɛm.
Megye medi sɛ mɛhunu AWURADE ayamyɛ,
ateasefoɔ asase so.
Ma w’ani nna AWURADE so,
hyɛ wo ho den na ma wo bo nyɛ duru,
Aane, ma w’ani nna AWURADE so.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
